scenario: LGRA.13.3 / LEXP.8.8 — a const RHS folds any compile-time-constant expression to a single value, not a bare literal only. `const DOUBLED = 2 * 5` folds to 10 and inlines at the reference site. Pin: compiles, the where-clause sees the folded literal.
rules_ds:
const DOUBLED = 2 * 5

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > DOUBLED
->
    log info "x"
